method: Separate author pass against canonical prompts, source history, authority boundary, migration history, failure retention and negative cases; not an independent reviewer.

criteria.reason: Exact target coverage and canonical aliases; 1–10 strict scores; local IDs and MANUAL provenance; atomic acceptance, rollback and restart.
Historical sources filtered before hydration; exact text and stored continuation survive restart without recursive reconstruction.
Explicit hash/revision approval; required per-source destination grants; escaped secrets blocked; no response-file authority; stale revision or binding rejected.
Initial and later CLI entry preserves spaces and blank lines; EOF cancels before staging; file intake remains available.
Aligned accepted participants satisfy round evidence only; next round requires user decision; every existing operation blocks silent manual replacement.
Populated V7 upgrade retains all published V1–V7 checksums; failed V8 rollback and two actual process-exit boundaries pass.
Fresh local Linux native graph passed; remote Windows/Linux run not yet started.

limitations: Manual mode must be explicitly registered; an existing product operation still requires a future explicit reconciliation path.
Local byte cap is not remote token measurement or history proof.
GUI textarea is scheduled P12, not implemented by this CLI slice.
Process exits do not prove power-loss durability; hashes do not authenticate fully coordinated database rewrites.
Full P04 criteria and trusted live observers remain open.
